nodes.label: Closure Table — Hierarchical Category Queries (t_d_article_hierarchy)
nodes.contributor: rationale: Chosen for O(1) hierarchical queries on article categories; supports max 10 depth levels. Trigger maintains ancestor/descendant/depth records. Prevents circular references and enforces max depth.

nodes.label: Window Exports Pattern — Public Functions via adapters/windowExports.ts
nodes.contributor: rationale: Avoids inline JS in HTML templates; all onclick-callable functions are exported via window.xxx in adapters/windowExports.ts. Enables TypeScript type safety and testability.
nodes.norm_label: window exports pattern — public functions via adapters/windowexports.ts

nodes.label: VERSION File — Single Source of Truth for Versioning
nodes.contributor: rationale: Pre-commit hook syncs package.json/package-lock.json with VERSION; CI/CD builds Docker images and updates IMAGE_VERSIONS.json on push. Semver major.minor.patch incremented by patch step per release.
nodes.norm_label: version file — single source of truth for versioning

nodes.label: Git Branch Policy — dev/* → test → prod Pipeline
nodes.contributor: rationale: PRs go dev/* → test only; prod branch contains only release-ready code. Branching from prod bypasses test-stage validation.
nodes.norm_label: git branch policy — dev/* → test → prod pipeline

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend Service — API + Web Pages
nodes.norm_label: fastapi backend service — api + web pages

nodes.label: Deploy Workflow — install.sh → setup.sh → deploy.sh
nodes.contributor: rationale: Three distinct roles: install.sh installs Docker/system deps (once); setup.sh syncs repo to /opt/budget + generates .env; deploy.sh starts/updates containers and runs migrations. Never run setup.sh from /opt/budget itself.

nodes.label: Offline-First Architecture — Dexie.js IndexedDB + WebSocket Sync
nodes.contributor: rationale: Transactions stored locally via Dexie (IndexedDB) first; sync with server via WebSocket when online. Write-behind pattern for instant UX. Content hash deduplication prevents duplicate creates on re-sync.
nodes.norm_label: offline-first architecture — dexie.js indexeddb + websocket sync

nodes.label: Dexie Removal Rationale
nodes.rationale: Remove Dexie.js offline sync entirely to eliminate duplicates, stuck pending operations, and cross-device stale data. All data flows through server REST API or WebSocket only. Architecture changes from: page → DataLayer → [Dexie (primary) | API (fallback)] to: page → API directly.

nodes.label: PWA Cold Start Splash Strategy
nodes.rationale: Show splash only on PWA cold start (app reopened), not on F5 reload or in-session navigation. Uses sessionStorage for cold-start detection and Performance API for reload detection. Minimum 2-second display time ensures visual continuity.

nodes.label: Service Worker Aggressive Update Strategy
nodes.rationale: Intentionally monolithic (436 lines) due to tight coupling between SW lifecycle events, update detection, and cleanup logic. Splitting into sub-modules would increase complexity. Update flow: detect version change → show 'new' indicator → user confirms → unregister SW → clear all caches → delete IndexedDB → clear storage → reload.

nodes.label: Identifier-First Login Flow
nodes.rationale: Multi-step login: first collect email/username, then check available auth methods via API, then offer WebAuthn biometric or password fallback. This allows progressive disclosure and supports devices without biometrics.
